source_text: 50 F0 wild An. gambiae mosquitoes were used for the detection of the L1014F and L1014S mutations by Taqman-kdr assay... However, the frequency of the L1014F (98.72%) mutation was very high compared to that of the L1014S (7.95%) mutation.
